name: Blessing
overview: The Scriptures reveal that God's blessing is both spiritual and temporal, bestowed upon His faithful followers as seen in His covenantal promises to Noah and Abraham. God blessed Noah and his sons to be fruitful and multiply after the flood (Genesis 9:1), and He assured Abraham of abundant offspring who would overcome their enemies (Genesis 22:17). Additionally, God's provision extends to all living creatures, granting them sustenance from the earth (Genesis 1:30), and His faithfulness endures through the regular cycles of nature (Genesis 8:22). These blessings are grounded in God's righteousness and obedience, as demonstrated by Noah's preservation in the ark (Genesis 7:1).
